tasks.name: Frontend insight contract types + presentation helpers
Frontend insight loader with dummy guard
Analytics page composition + scoped degradation + AI trust labels

decisions.summary: Option A — extend AnalyticsService + a new controller action rather than a new service/route surface. Dashboard path (dashboard()/salesTrends()/outletPerformance()) kept byte-for-byte; money arithmetic stays on the existing integer-cents path (decimalToCents/moneyFromCents) with no second rounding path.

Insight window is FIXED at 30 days: /analytics/insight ignores start_date/end_date query params (end = today). Comparison window = current 30d vs immediately-preceding 30d; delta direction derived from the unrounded ratio, previous==0 → null.
Access gate is isAdminOrOwner (admin + platform_owner) at the controller/route level; outlet user → 403 with {status:'error'} envelope, no token → 401, inactive platform_owner → 403.

needs_attention is server-qualified (sales_decline ≥20% on unrounded cents, or point-in-time outstanding > 0), collapse both-reason outlets to a single sales_decline row, capped at 5, declines ranked before outstanding with deterministic name/id tie-break.

Page uses two independent loads (loadAnalyticsInsight + loadAnalytics) so each section degrades alone; useDummyRefresh re-drives BOTH loaders on a dummy-flag flip (previously only loadAnalytics). platform_owner treated admin-equivalent for adminOnly nav visibility.
